title: Editing the matrix later never changes what a line recorded
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, with one range from $0.00: Default Markup % 50, tier A Markup % 20.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test, part A, in category A, cost $10.00, in a bin (for example E-11).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for work orders.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with part A added (sold at $12.00: $10.00 × 1.20).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Replace tier A's value with 40.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Open work order 1.
  7. Point at part A's sell price on the Lines tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 4:

  • Tier A's value reads 40.

Step 5:

  • The grid saves with tier A on 40% markup.

Step 6:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 7:

  • Part A still sells at $12.00 ($10.00 × 1.20 = $12.00).
  • The details still show the rule 20% markup, not 40%.
